{{Top|leg}}
The '''Master Command Unit''', also known as a '''master-control unit''' or '''master control unit''', was a small box-like component with multiple switches usually worn at the belt. It handled many minor programs such as lighting, portals, and [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#C|commo]]. The unit could also network more advanced systems like primary defense and security systems. The master-control unit itself was not self-contained and needed ancillary equipment to link the small unit to its primary control circuitry. Before its destruction around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the ancillary system at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] had receptor circuitry built into the walls of the tower, always in close proximity to the master-control unit that [[Mirkovig Hirken|Viceprex Hirken]] carried.
